source_law: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. CI proves. Human promotes.
purpose: Reusable workflow for document, manual, template, manifest, HTML companion, receipt, and source-of-truth mutations.

allowed: inspect current doctrine and sources of truth
stage documentation changes on a non-release branch
save verified documentation copies to designated documentation storage
forbidden_without_separate_crown_action: loopback control plane in Android runtime
claiming software GREEN from documentation evidence

hydra_learning_loop.name: Quest
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Define the objective before touching the machine.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Scout
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Inspect current state, source, dependencies, and real artifacts. Do not mutate yet.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Plan
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Choose the smallest safe change. Identify rollback and required evidence.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Test
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Run the test that matches the claim.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Collect Receipts
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Collect hashes, renders, parse results, links, logs, source references, or other evidence matching the claim.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Gate
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Use GREEN, AMBER, RED, or UNKNOWN. Never promote UNKNOWN or AMBER by enthusiasm.

hydra_learning_loop.name: Seal
hydra_learning_loop.rule: Update the source of truth, preserve receipts, record the mutation, list blockers, and identify the next safe state.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Authority
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Resolve the current canonical repository, branch, doctrine, and human authority before editing.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Scope
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: State exactly what may change and what remains outside this mutation.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Freshness
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Prefer current source-of-truth records over legacy Hydra, KAI, Vue, Termux, or historical receipts.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Voice
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Use short sentences. Use complete thoughts. Keep the Professor and Lum voice where useful.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Evidence
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Each claim must match its receipt. A file existing proves only that the file exists.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Security
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: No secrets, private keys, bearer tokens, production signing material, or private control-plane details in public-facing documentation.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Structure
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Check table of contents, headings, links, appendices, page flow, and cross-references.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Machine Readability
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Validate the AI JSON manifest and HTML companion. Keep schema, authority, status, and provenance explicit.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Render and Hash
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Render the human artifact, inspect every page or view, then calculate SHA-256 receipts for final files.

ten_pass_hard_audit.name: Seal and Save
ten_pass_hard_audit.gate: Write a documentation seal. Save only verified outputs to the designated documentation source. Keep software promotion separate.

status_semantics.GREEN: Verified by evidence matching the claim.
status_semantics.AMBER: Promising or partial. Proof is still missing.
status_semantics.UNKNOWN: Not checked. Unknown is acceptable. Fake GREEN is not.

artifact_contract.human_master: Document or print artifact appropriate to the request.
artifact_contract.html_companion: Single-column, readable, scriptless companion when requested or useful for in-app reference.
artifact_contract.ai_manifest: Plain JSON is canonical machine-readable metadata. Base64 may wrap transport only and is not security.
artifact_contract.documentation_seal: Records source authority, scope, hashes, checks, unresolved items, and exact gate state.
artifact_contract.hash_ledger: SHA-256 hashes for sealed output files.
artifact_contract.receipt: One receipt per claim where practical.

save_contract.repository: Stage documentation mutations in the canonical repository. Keep release promotion separate.
save_contract.drive: Save verified copies only to a designated documentation folder. A convenience copy does not become source of truth unless explicitly crowned.
save_contract.legacy: Reference selectively. Do not overwrite current doctrine with older architecture merely because an older document is more detailed.

rollback_rule: Unify first. Delete last. Prefer reversible documentation mutations and preserve the previous canonical state.
voice_rule: A joke may introduce the lesson. The technical meaning must immediately follow.
final_rule: Build weird things. Keep receipts. Pet the demon. Do not lie to the status board.
